description: Personal planning estimates. Inputs live only in the page URL and this browser.

options.content: 🎓 GradPath🏠 Overview🧭 My Plan🏫 Schools🗺️ States & Taxes📊 Graphs❓ Help

My Plan

Estimates from your own answers plus historical College Scorecard data. Nothing here is stored on a server.

✏️ Edit my inputs

**What the labels mean:** 📘 Historical College Scorecard data · ✏️ You entered · 🧮 Calculated estimate · ⚙️ Assumption · ❔ Missing information. New here? Use **Edit my inputs** to open the planning form.

panels.title: 📘 Historical median earnings
panels.description: Median earnings 2 years after completion for matching programs. Not a salary guarantee.

panels.title: 📘 Historical median debt
panels.description: Median federal loan debt at completion for matching programs.

panels.title: 🧮 Total estimated education cost
panels.description: (Tuition + living expenses) × years in school. Uses Scorecard tuition if you left it blank.

panels.title: 🧮 Savings available at enrollment
panels.description: Current savings + yearly contributions until you start. No investment growth assumed.

panels.title: ✏️ Scholarships & grants total
panels.description: Your yearly scholarships and grants × years in school.

panels.title: 🧮 Estimated funding gap
panels.description: Cost − grants − savings at enrollment − savings added while in school. Before any borrowing.

panels.title: 🧮 Savings coverage
panels.description: Share of total cost covered by your own savings (capped at 100%).

panels.title: 🧮 Gap left after planned borrowing
panels.description: Funding gap − total planned borrowing. Above zero means the plan does not yet cover all costs.

panels.title: ✏️ Total new borrowing
panels.description: Expected borrowing per year × years in school.

panels.title: ⚙️ Interest rate used
panels.description: Your rate, or 6.52% (2026–27 federal undergraduate Direct Loan rate) if left blank.

panels.title: 🧮 Estimated debt when repayment starts
panels.description: Existing balance + new borrowing + simple interest that builds up in school and during a 6-month grace period.

panels.title: 🧮 Standard 10-year monthly payment
panels.description: Fixed monthly payment that clears the balance in 120 months at your interest rate.

panels.title: 🧮 Total interest (standard 10-year plan)
panels.description: All payments minus the starting balance on the standard plan.

panels.title: 🧮 Estimated debt-free date range
panels.description: Earliest to latest payoff month across your three salary scenarios (YYYY-MM).

panels.title: 🧮 Salary scenarios — conservative, expected, aspirational
panels.description: Payment = the larger of the 10-year standard payment and your chosen share of salary.

options.content: These are **educational estimates**, not financial or tax advice. Historical earnings do not guarantee future salary; your occupation, location, employer and experience will matter.

<small>📘 **Source:** U.S. Department of Education, [College Scorecard](https://collegescorecard.ed.gov/data/) — Field of Study and Institution files (release 2026-10-05). **Data year:** 2021–22 completers (earnings measured 2023–24).  Historical outcomes, not guarantees.
